heroText: Hello, I am Ann-Kathrin Rahlwes, a historian from Frankfurt am Main. I support you in finding historical evidence, researching history and communicating it in a simple, clear and exciting way.

services.title: Find historical documents
services.text: I research archives, collections and databases and find the sources that prove your story.
services.imageAlt: A woman examines something under a microscope, another holds a box of books.

services.title: Understanding old documents & photographs
services.text: I read and interpret historical writings, letters and pictures and place them in their context.
services.imageAlt: A teapot in the centre, a hand holding a notebook.

services.title: Communicating history
services.text: I tell history simply, clearly and excitingly - for exhibitions, digital formats and teaching.
services.imageAlt: A hand holding an open book. This is about communicating history.

aboutBlocks.title: My approach
aboutBlocks.text: I want to get people excited about history and encourage them to engage with historical topics. That's why it's important to me to convey history in a simple, clear and exciting way. In doing so, I rely on in-depth knowledge, innovative topics and methods such as storytelling.

aboutBlocks.title: My training
aboutBlocks.text: I studied political science, medieval and modern history and philosophy and was involved in historical and political education work for many years. This still influences my work today: my exhibition concepts are inclusive and participatory, and in my research I am interested in social-historical approaches.

aboutBlocks.title: My focus
aboutBlocks.text: I research biographies and family histories and deal with memorabilia, correspondence and memoirs. Who were the people who preceded us? How did they live and work? What was important to them? What did they do to change their situation? These questions help us to explore and understand how people saw themselves and the world they lived in.

aboutBlocks.title: Passing on knowledge
aboutBlocks.text: I find new inspiration for my work at conferences, at further training courses and in exchanges with colleagues in the field. I pass on my knowledge to my clients, exhibition teams and in workshops.

testimonials.quote: Ann-Kathrin Rahlwes is an absolute professional, extremely creative and has a very pleasant communication style. She is fun and interesting to work with.
testimonials.author: Judith Rosenthal

testimonials.quote: Ann-Kathrin Rahlwes joined the design of our permanent exhibition at an advanced stage and has noticeably enriched the further process with her in-depth expertise and experience in communicating recent migration history. Her strong sense of initiative and her ability to recognize challenges early on and deal with them constructively deserve special mention. Working with her was always productive and also great fun.
testimonials.author: PD Dr. Florian Greiner
testimonials.role: Managing Director of the Learning and Remembrance Site Notaufnahmelager Gießen gGmbH

aboutText: Anyone who studies history understands the connections between past and present and can develop strategies for the future. The central question is: How can we shape the future according to our values and ideas?
journalText: In my journal, I regularly report on my work and give tips for historical research on biographies and the communication of historical knowledge.
